name: HBR DefenseDown icon
transformation: 2026-11-08: the first-batch blue down arrow composited over the original texture, drawn by the same code and parameters as hbr_spirit_down_power.png (Pillow polygon, 8x supersampled then LANCZOS to 64x64, dark outline, bottom-right corner). Every pixel outside the arrow layer is unchanged; no resizing, recoloring of other pixels, crop or AI generation. Before this, the file was a byte-identical copy of the original (originalCopySha256).

processing.reason: User decision 「也补上」 (relayed by the 全局统筹 session): the down icons get the same down arrow as Spirit Down, so they read apart from hbr_defense_up_power.png, which shares this base art with an up arrow.
processing.arrow: down, fill #50A8FF, outline #181620, centre (50.5, 49.0), 20x15 px, inner triangle 0.62

identityEvidence.label: SpecialStatus.DefenseDown
identityEvidence.note: The original game shares this base artwork with the corresponding buff. AttackDown/DefenseDown are identified explicitly by their special-status records; their debuff label is rendered separately by the game. This imports the exact original base texture without synthesizing a badge or arrow.

usage.note: The indexed original has one 64x64 Texture2D and its Sprite. Both icon roles reuse this badged image.

limits: Original icon asset identity and provenance only. No Godot importer, package or game run was performed.
